text: Such integral score more test runs than anyone in history but according to the ICC at least 30 betters had a better peak than him. His highest ever test getting 898 Virat Kohli peaked at 937 even Sunil Gavaskar went past 900. So how is the greatest running score of all time is not even in top 30 but before we understand why if you are a true cricket man you must follow this page. Here is how the rating works. It's not a career score it's a moving average and your recent matches count the most.

And it does not treat every run the same, run against strong teams and the runs that win matches earn more. That is problem number one. Some of Sachin's greatest inning tests, hundreds came in losses. 114 in Perth, 169 in Capdown, 136 in Chennai against Pakistan. India lost all of them. Problem number two. Right after his peak in 2002, tennis elbow hit him. The bad matches dragged the average down and it never recovered to that height. He became number one again in 2010, but even then, 898 stayed his ceiling.
Maybe his greatness was never the peak, it was the mountain range. Peak or longevity, what matters most? Tell me in the comments and follow for more.
